anchors.title: Australian War Memorial
anchors.description: Australia's national shrine and one of the world's great military museums. Free entry. Plan to be there for the Last Post ceremony at 4:55pm — a daily commemoration honouring a different fallen Australian.

anchors.title: National Gallery of Australia
anchors.description: Free entry to Australia's national collection — 155,000 works including Aboriginal Memorial poles, Jackson Pollock's Blue Poles, and major works by Sidney Nolan, Margaret Olley and Rover Thomas.

anchors.title: Parliament House — Free Tour
anchors.description: Free 30-minute guided tour of Australia's national legislature, beneath the iconic 81-metre flagpole. Walk on the roof for one of the best views in Canberra. Open every day.

anchors.title: National Museum of Australia
anchors.description: Free, family-friendly museum on the shores of Lake Burley Griffin telling 65,000 years of Australian history. Don't miss the iconic Holden Prototype, Phar Lap's heart and the K'gari (Fraser Island) galleries.

anchors.title: Lake Burley Griffin Loop
anchors.description: 28km cycling and walking circuit around the lake at the centre of Burley Griffin's city plan. Hire a bike at Bike Stop Cafe, ride past the Captain Cook Memorial Water Jet and stop at Pollen for lunch.

anchors.title: Mt Ainslie Lookout
anchors.description: 843m-high lookout with a perfect alignment along Anzac Parade through the city to Parliament House. Easy walking track from the War Memorial or drive to the top for sunset photos.

SATURDAY.title: Capital Region Farmers Market
SATURDAY.description: Canberra's biggest weekend market — 100+ stalls of fresh produce direct from regional growers at the Exhibition Park. Every Saturday 7:30am-11:30am.

SUNDAY.title: Old Bus Depot Markets
SUNDAY.description: Canberra's much-loved Sunday market under the sawtooth roof of the 1930s tram depot in Kingston. 200+ stalls of design, crafts, gourmet food and live performance.
